1164-8266.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1164-8266.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing no cards and exiling your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using any creature. Fblthp triggers, causing you to win the game.

2023-3755-4518-7296.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1687-6888-8095.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-4050-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4050-7173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a basic land you control

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

7009-7309-7803.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
7009-7309-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
7009-7309-7803.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Brad Boimler.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3933-4929-5479-7803.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
3933-4929-5479-7803.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

5361-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5361-7009-7715.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2816-7704.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Doc Samson.
2816-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Doc Samson by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1368-4068-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one Mountain.
1368-4068-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2173-2469-5220-5933.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

494-7439.description:
Cast a copy of Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Ribbons from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and all remaining available mana, causing each opponent to lose a significant amount of life.
494-7439.notes: The more life you have, the more life your opponents will lose. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Ribbons.

5184-5742-5743-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

165-1069-4478-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-4478-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-3259-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
955-3259-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

3490-6006-7075-7292.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-7075-7292.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

1849-3259-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
1849-3259-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

4681-5170-5686-6794.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3781-4191-6798--122.description:
Cast the Insect from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast the Insect from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Resolve the Zask ability, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1429-5256-6792.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2034-2279-5795-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2279-5795-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

1308-1563-2457-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

325-602-3017-6282.easyPrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
325-602-3017-6282.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Toluz trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

465-647-803-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-647-803-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1274-3188-3490-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3188-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

144-628-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 5, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

643-1238-2351-2511-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

509-1267-1379-3933.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-1379-3933.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-1379-3933.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

235-386-5438.description:
Cast Explosive Singularity by paying at most {8}{R}{R}, dealing 10 damage to any creature.
Imodane triggers, giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

1919-2580.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Lethal Vapors triggers, destroying that creature.
Because Sorcerous Spyglass prevents Lethal Vapors's activated ability from being activated, it cannot be destroyed due to its ability.

1550-4068-4251.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4068-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

141-4499-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three lands.
141-4499-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control at least four lands, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

4763-4766-5147.notablePrerequisites: Deahrender attached to another nontoken creature you control.
4763-4766-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Koll and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

198-617-4331.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least one charge counter on it.
198-617-4331.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Voltaic Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Voltaic Key by paying {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2047-3094-4600-4659.notablePrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to Lithoform Engine.
2047-3094-4600-4659.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mechanized Production's ability, creating a token copy of Lithoform Engine.
Activate the Lithoform Engine token's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Lithoform Engine token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1283-2107-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Sunastian Falconer.
Sunastian Falconer does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2107-3525.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Sunastian Falconer.
Repeat.

2837-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2837-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

323-2034-2308.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
323-2034-2308.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3429-3554-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Invent by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Invent and Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
